zombifiedplayer.spawn.message: A zombified version of yourself now roams this world...
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.title: Zombified Player
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.s: Spawn a zombified player after death
If enabled, a zombified player will spawn after the player gets killed by an Undead | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.t: Transfer the players Main and Off-Hand to the zombified player
If enabled, the Main and the Off Hand of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
Transfer the players Armor to the zombified player
If enabled, the Armor of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
Transfer the players Inventory to the zombified player
If enabled, the Inventory of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
Transfer the players curios items to the zombified player
If enabled, all equipped curios items of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.i: If enabled, the items are transferred to the zombified player even with keepInventory. If disabled, the player keeps the items with keepInventory and the zombified player spawns without them | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.s: Spawn zombified player no matter how the player died
If enabled, a zombified player will spawn no matter how the player died | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.d: Display name tag for the zombified player
If enabled, the zombified player will display the name of the dead player | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.r: Player names for zombified players that do not come from a player death (/summon, spawn egg, spawner). One name is picked at random and its skin is used. Empty: Steve | default: jeb_, Dinnerbone, XxRexRaptorxX, McModsPete
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.n: If enabled, zombified players also spawn naturally in the dark wherever zombies spawn. They get a skin from the random skins list, drop their equipment only by chance like zombies and despawn like zombies. Applied when the world is loaded | default: disabled
Spawn weight of naturally spawning zombified players, compared to zombies (95) and zombie villagers (5) in most biomes. Applied when the world is loaded | default: 5
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.d: Display name tag for naturally spawned zombified players
If enabled, naturally spawned zombified players display the name tag "Zombified <name>" (needs the name tag option above) | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.p: Print spawn messages for the zombified player to the chat
If enabled, a message will be printed out in chat that a zombified player has spawned | default: enabled
Print spawn location of the zombified player to the chat
If enabled, spawn location of the zombified player will be printed out in chat | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.z: Zombified Players can always break doors
If enabled, zombified players can break through wooden doors on every difficulty. If disabled, only on hard difficulty like zombies (both need the game rule mobGriefing) | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.m: If enabled, zombified players are stronger, faster and have more health | default: disabled
Make Zombified Players immune to lava and fire
If enabled, zombified players are immune to lava and fire | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.l: If unsuccessful, stop trying to fetch the player skin
If enabled, the mod will stop trying to fetch the player skin after several unsuccessful tries | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.s:
[Please note]
For the option below the mod Contagion needs to be installed!
Spawn Zombified Player after death by infection
If enabled, spawn Zombified Player if player died from an infection | default: enabled

[Please note]
For the option below the mod Contagion needs to be installed!
Spawn Zombified Player when dying while infected
If enabled, spawn Zombified Player if the player dies while infected, no matter how (e.g. fall damage), not only from the infection itself | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.i:
[Please note]
For the option below the Infectious mod needs to be installed!
Spawn Zombified Player when killed by Infectious Zombies
If enabled, spawn Zombified Player if player is killed by an Infectious Zombie | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.u: Use zombie models from resource packs

If enabled, zombie models from resource packs (Entity Model Features, e.g. Fresh Animations) also change zombified players. Packs with their own zombie models and textures (e.g. Bray's Zombie Overhaul) make the player skin look broken. Applied after reloading resource packs (F3+T) | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.c:
[Please note]
For the option below the Corpse mod needs to be installed!
Don't create a corpse when a Zombified Player spawns
If enabled, no corpse (Corpse mod) will spawn when a zombified player spawns | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.g:
[Please note]
For the option below the Gravestone mod needs to be installed!
Don't create a gravestone when a Zombified Player spawns
If enabled, no gravestone will be placed when a zombified player spawns | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.u: If enabled, the zombified player will use a custom eye height | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.c: The custom eye height of the zombified player (only used if 'Use custom eye height' is enabled) | default: 1.74
